t: Real Research Today: Asteroid Belt Civilization
title: Real Research Today: Asteroid Belt Civilization
definition: Today's documented research behind Asteroid Belt Civilization.
description:
The road to Asteroid Belt Civilization is already being paved. CERN's antimatter research (ALPHA, AEgIS) studies antimatter properties relevant to far-future propulsion physics. Project Hyperion ran an international design competition for crewed generation-ship concepts.

The 100 Year Starship project (DARPA/NASA seeded) studies the capabilities needed for interstellar flight within a century. Together these programs form the spin habitats foundation that Asteroid Belt Civilization will build on — the belt logistics results, the mining economy methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as belt logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First long-duration belter culture testbed runs a sealed rock hu
title: 2032 — First long-duration belter culture testbed runs a sealed rock hu
definition: 2032 milestone on the Asteroid Belt Civilization roadmap.
description:
First long-duration belter culture testbed runs a sealed rock hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the spin habitats recycling math.

What must be true first: the spin habitats results have to replicate outside the lab, belt logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and mining economy operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed spin habitats demonstrations, belt logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting mining economy uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Asteroid Belt Civilization
definition: Estimates Asteroid Belt Civilization readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Asteroid Belt Civilization components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a rock hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Asteroid Belt Civilization Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Asteroid Belt Civilization operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Asteroid Belt Civilization installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 99682 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where spin habitats monitoring, belt logistics redundancy, or mining economy maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Asteroid Belt Civilization Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Asteroid Belt Civilization: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Asteroid Belt Civilization — a whole civilization living in and on the asteroids.

Phase 1 — Prove (spin habitats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (belt logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mining economy): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (belter culture): rock hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and main belt-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
